items.title: Hank Cicalo interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 30, 2022
items.q: I’ve worked with guys like Vic Damone

ctx.x: I said no one ever asks for less. © Fillius Jazz Archive -7-

Yeah sure. If you have a good mix in the phones it gives the artist — whoever the artist might be — it might be with a guitar player in the room — you’ve got to make them all feel comfortable. The earphones are really important. You get that really good balance in the earphones — I would do things like guys would put on the phones immediately and start, “No, no, no.” I’d say, “Give me a chance to get a mix and we’ll work on the phones after that.” And generally that usually worked. Even at the beginning of the…
I told you that I am a huge fan of Cannonball Adderley. I wondered, when you recorded them did Cannonball and Nat have to be in a separate booth?
